transcripts.text: Have you worked on a reception desk previously?
No, I haven’t. I had a baby quite young, and so I have very little work experience.
Could you tell me a few more details?
Yes, of course. The job will be to mainly provide quality customer service both over the phone and in person.

transcripts.text: Do you have any information about the hours involved?
It says here that you will be expected to work several early mornings, 4 days a week.

No, it says here that they only require you to work on weekdays, not weekends.

transcripts.text: Homestays are ideal for both travellers and homeowners, enabling inter-cultural exchanges and the development of life-long friendships, while providing travellers with often discounted accommodation costs, and host families with a steady income from the comfort of their own homes.

questions.question: What is the guest expected to overcome when suffering from culture shock?

explanation.detailExplanation: [{"type":"p","children":[{"text":""},{"type":"ICON","iconKey":"smiley16","children":[{"text":""}]},{"text":" Nghe thấy \"Connection’s advice for those suffering from "},{"text":"culture shock, ","bold":true},{"text":"is to go out and "},{"text":"make as many friends as possible","bold":true},{"text":", "},{"text":"no matter ","bold":true},{"text":"how "},{"text":"difficult ","bold":true},{"text":"you may find it.\" "}]},{"type":"p","children":[{"text":"=> Các khách trải qua culture shock "},{"text":"nên ra ngoài kết bạn cho dù có khó cỡ nào đi nữa\n=> Đáp án là B ","bold":true},{"type":"ICON","iconKey":"check","children":[{"text":""}]},{"text":""}]}]

transcripts.text: Connection’s advice for those suffering from culture shock, is to go out and make as many friends as possible, no matter how difficult you may find it.

questions.question: What can the guests do if they want to become familiar with host families?

explanation.detailExplanation: [{"type":"p","children":[{"text":""},{"type":"ICON","iconKey":"smiley16","children":[{"text":""}]},{"text":" Mình cần nghe xem ","marks":[]},{"text":"khách có thể làm gì nếu muốn thân hơn với chủ nhà","marks":[],"bold":true}]},{"type":"p","children":[{"text":""},{"type":"ICON","iconKey":"smiley26","children":[{"text":""}]},{"text":"Sau khi nghe \" "},{"text":"develop a very close and almost familiar relationship","bold":true},{"text":". \" "}]},{"type":"p","children":[{"text":"=> Biết đáp án chuẩn bị vào"}]},{"type":"p","children":[{"text":"\n"},{"type":"ICON","iconKey":"smiley4","children":[{"text":""}]},{"text":" Nghe thấy \"they have found "},{"text":"discussing","bold":true},{"text":" "},{"text":"their hobbies ","bold":true},{"text":"and other "},{"text":"interests with their host families","bold":true},{"text":" is the best way "},{"text":"to overcome any barriers","bold":true},{"text":"\" "}]},{"type":"p","children":[{"text":"=> "},{"text":"Chia sẻ sở thích với host families","bold":true},{"text":" là cách để vượt qua rào cản/ thân mật hơn"},{"text":"\n=> Đáp án là A ","bold":true},{"type":"ICON","iconKey":"check","children":[{"text":""}]},{"text":""}]}]

transcripts.text: At first, it might seem extremely challenging to overcome the language barrier between you and your host family; however, you will find that you quickly overcome this and develop a very close and almost familial relationship.

Many of our travellers have suggested that  they have found discussing their hobbies and other interests with their host families is the best way to overcome any barriers, since you are more than likely to find something you share in common.

questions.question: What’s likely to happen to the guests in the long run?

options.value: They will know more people from different countries.

transcripts.text: After the first few weeks, you will find your understanding of the people around you and their culture deepens by leaps and bounds, and you will soon become one of the locals. Our hosts, in over 140 countries, turn a location into a culture, time into experience and strangers into friends.

Do you think we’ll need to include that many participants in a focus group?
Blimey, Douglas, well done for finding that many willing children, but you definitely don’t need that many for the study you’re going to undertake.
I’d say you need no more than five children per group, and no more than three groups, so fifteen children altogether.
You definitely need to control the group size in order to generate a meaningful dialogue.
